final_architecture_decision: Keep four mechanisms: absolute, relative, residual, and independently confirmed momentum. Parameter changes are robustness, not new hypotheses.
Separate short pressure reversal, robust state deviation, and residual reversal. Pair trading remains extension-tier because formation and costs add degrees of freedom.
Use point-in-time accounting vintages and one primary definition per mechanism. Alternative denominators are robustness only.
Separate participation, price impact, and attention. Do not interpret volume mechanically as liquidity or alpha.
Model volatility as a multiscale state and retain downside, path-dependent drawdown, and option-implied risk as distinct mechanisms.
Separate bad-market co-movement, common-mode concentration, and directional spillovers. Specialized SRISK/CoVaR approximations require their real inputs.
Use contract-aware definitions and a common economic ontology, while preserving asset-class conventions and roll mechanics.
Use publication-time vintages, joint macro states, and surprises. Macro levels alone are not treated as stable return predictors.
Separate event surprise from post-event drift; calendar effects require pre-registration and strict event-time alignment.
Separate direction, novelty, reach, evidence quality, disagreement, and narrative change. Never collapse all text/social signals into sentiment.
Interpretable matrices remain mandatory. Sparse PCA is champion; one shallow self-supervised encoder is an optional challenger. Predictive latent factors belong to P5.
Use family budgets, complete attempt ledger, nested temporal evaluation, multiplicity-aware confirmation, and a sealed final holdout.
Missingness is a state, not zero. Preserve publication, availability, revision, and ingestion timestamps.
